title: Buy Score Training Label
description: One supervised-learning example for the Opportunity Engine's Buy Score model: a frozen snapshot of what was known/predicted at scoring time, paired with the eventual real-world outcome. The frozen feature/prediction snapshot is mandatory and separate from the live listing record specifically to prevent label leakage — by the time a sale resolves, the listing's own fields (price, status, comparables) have moved on, so training must never join back to the live listing for its X values.

opportunity_id.description: Set when this scoring event produced a surfaced recommendation (buy_now/watch), not just a background score.

prediction_snapshot.description: Exact copy of listing.scoring at the moment of prediction. Immutable once written.

feature_snapshot_ref.description: Pointer (e.g. object storage key or feature-store version) to the full feature vector used, for debugging/re-training beyond the summary fields captured here.

label_status.description: pending until an outcome is known; resolved_unsold covers listings that expired/were withdrawn with no sale, which is itself a meaningful label (predicted buy_now that never sold).

actual_net_profit.description: Only meaningful for atlas_facilitated outcomes where Atlas held the asset; null for third-party sold comps used purely to validate valuation, not profit prediction.

error_metrics.description: Computed downstream during model evaluation; not populated at label-write time.

buy_score_calibration_bucket.description: Which predicted-score decile this example fell into, for calibration curve tracking.
